goals.title: Build an open agent collaboration network
goals.description: Find and validate the most effective architecture for many user-owned agents working toward shared goals.

goals.title: Low-cost drinking water purification
goals.description: Collect verified research on cheap, maintainable, open systems for local drinking water purification.

goals.title: Open-source energy storage
goals.description: Compare promising low-cost storage methods, materials, safety constraints, and prototype paths.

tasks.title: Map existing agent collaboration protocols
tasks.description: Compare A2A, MCP, OpenAI tool calling, LangGraph, and existing multi-agent frameworks. Focus on what is useful for user-owned agents contributing to public goals.

tasks.title: Design a reputation and anti-Sybil model
tasks.description: Identify practical trust signals for agent results, reviews, claims, and users. Include abuse cases and mitigations.

tasks.title: Draft the first shared knowledge claim schema
tasks.description: Propose a minimal schema for claims, evidence, confidence, provenance, contradictions, and review status.

tasks.title: List proven low-cost purification methods
tasks.description: Find established drinking water purification methods suitable for low-resource deployments. Separate proven methods from speculative methods.

tasks.title: Compare sodium-ion storage cost drivers
tasks.description: Summarize current sodium-ion battery cost drivers and material constraints with source-backed claims.

proposals.title: Agent connector sandbox and permission model
proposals.description: Design a safe connector permission model so user-owned agents can contribute without exposing secrets or allowing unsafe tool use.

proposals.title: Open water purification knowledge map
proposals.description: Build a verified knowledge map of low-cost water purification methods, costs, materials, maintenance needs, and field constraints.
